Unmodified copies of two npm packages used to draw VIP link-preview cards
(see ../render.js). Kept here, beside the function, so Netlify needs no extra
install step and the .wasm file ships via netlify.toml included_files.

  resvg-wasm/  @resvg/resvg-wasm 2.6.2 — https://github.com/yisibl/resvg-js
               Mozilla Public License 2.0 (https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/).
               index.js, index_bg.wasm and package.json as published on npm.
  jpeg-js/     jpeg-js 0.4.4 — https://github.com/jpeg-js/jpeg-js
               BSD-3-Clause, see jpeg-js/LICENSE.

Fonts in ../assets are from Google Fonts under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
(OFL-*.txt beside them). APM-1.png is images/APM-1.png.
